svg.title: Ktemata r5 airbrush scheme - MERIDIAN
svg.desc: Continuity: the graticule is laid out from the hinge at L/10 = 17.81 mm pitch on both parts, so line n is the same distance from the seam on either half and the chart runs on across it. Every fifth line and the two end rules are amber, the rest ash. Each line is drawn only where there is plate: measured against the model, the grid meets the Pi opening, the fan, the keyboard well, the display opening and the screw heads, and stops dead at each. On the flat cover the graticule may cross the painted border; the later slate pass covers it there. Actual apertures and reserved type still stop every line. Nothing is touched up by hand, so the grid reads as one chart with holes punched through it rather than as a pattern that gives up.
